# nagios_contact (Data Source)

Reads an existing Nagios XI contact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nagios_contact" "example" {
  contact_name = "jdoe"
}

output "jdoe_email" {
  value = data.nagios_contact.example.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_name` (String) The name of the contact

### Read-Only

- `address1` (String) Defines additional 'addresses' for the contact
- `address2` (String) Defines additional 'addresses' for the contact
- `address3` (String) Defines additional 'addresses' for the contact
- `alias` (String) A longer name or description for the contact
- `can_submit_commands` (Boolean) Determines whether or not the contact can submit external commands to Nagios from the CGIs
- `contact_groups` (Set of String) The short name(s) of the contactgroup(s) that the contact belongs to
- `email` (String) Defines an email address for the contact
- `host_notification_commands` (Set of String) A list of the short names of the commands used to notify the contact of a host problem or recovery
- `host_notification_options` (String) The host states for which notifications can be sent out to this contact
- `host_notification_period` (String) The short name of the time period during which the contact can be notified about host problems or recoveries
- `host_notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Determines whether or not the contact will receive notifications about host problems and recoveries
- `pager` (String) Defines a pager number for the contact
- `retain_nonstatus_information` (Boolean) Determines whether or not non-status information about the contact is retained across program restarts.
- `retain_status_information` (Boolean) Determines whether or not status-related information about the contact is retained across program restarts
- `service_notification_commands` (Set of String) A list of the short names of the commands used to notify the contact of a service problem or recovery
- `service_notification_options` (String) The service states for which notifications can be sent out to this contact
- `service_notification_period` (String) The short name of the time period during which the contact can be notified about service problems or recoveries
- `service_notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Determines whether or not the contact will receive notifications about service problems and recoveries
- `templates` (Set of String) The contact templates to apply to the contact
